Module 6 (green) holds atomized AlSi10Mg from a rePowder run, its 20-63 µm cut. The carousel indexes it to the station, 8 chain links per module, and the Actuonix P16 docks the electronics carriage under its plate, magnet on.

Module 6 (green) holds atomized AlSi10Mg from a rePowder run, its 20-63 µm cut. The carousel indexes it to the station, 8 chain links per module, and the Actuonix P16 docks the electronics carriage under its plate, magnet on. The other modules are drawn see-through: the docked one rides inside the loop.

Module 6 tilts 30°, cap end up, and the auger turns in short steps until the load cell reads 25 mg: a heap 6 mm across, drawn to scale. DAL asks for a weighed 10-50 mg; mg resolution is a requirement on the doser (byu-vcl PR #270 §5), not yet shown. Then tilt back, reverse one turn at rest, undock.

The CubXL's own P20 (1-20 µL) takes a 20 µL tip, the capper lifts the seawater cap, and 10 transfers of 20 µL put 200 µL on the powder, 0.4 mm deep (to scale). The copper deck's chloride stock is seawater; DAL's §8 names 0.6 M NaCl.
